Visit this website regularly for updates or [follow us on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-use-of-r-in-official-statistics-uros/posts).

[← Back to the uRos2026 conference page](index.qmd) · [Slides](slides.qmd)

## Venue

The conference will be hosted by INSEE at the premises of the Ministry of Economics.

Conference venue: Pierre Mendès France Conference Center, 139 Rue de Bercy, 75012 Paris, France.

- **19th of November:** Welcome message & Keynote speaker 1 & Sessions of presentations
- **20th of November:** Keynote speaker 2 & Sessions of presentations & Closing remarks
